sentences.en: A bright fire was glowing in the old-fashioned Waterloo stove.
sentences.zh: 在老式的滑铁卢炉子里燃着一团明亮的火光。

sentences.en: Call me old-fashioned, but I see myself as a puritan.
sentences.zh: 虽说我有点守旧，但我自认为是个清教徒。

sentences.en: He raised me with a lot of old-fashioned medical beliefs.
sentences.zh: 他用许多过时的医学观念把我抚养长大。
